info.title: Uno Platform DevServer CLI
info.description: CLI tool for managing the Uno Platform DevServer — local development server for Hot Reload, IDE integration, and AI-powered MCP tools.

commands.name: disco
commands.description: Discover environment and SDK details

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON output

options.name: --addins-only
options.description: Output only resolved add-in paths (semicolon-separated, or JSON array with --json)

commands.name: health
commands.description: Report Uno DevServer health for the current workspace

commands.name: list
commands.description: List active DevServer instances

commands.name: install
commands.description: Register MCP servers in client config files

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message and exit

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Set the log level (Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None). Default is Information.

options.name: --file-log
options.description: Enable file logging to the provided file path (supports {Date} token). Required path argument.

options.name: --solution-dir
options.description: Explicit solution root when priming tools without client-provided roots

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON output

options.name: --addins-only
options.description: Output only resolved add-in paths (semicolon-separated, or JSON array with --json)

options.name: --mcp-app
options.description: Start in App MCP STDIO mode

options.name: --mcp-wait-tools-list
options.description: Wait for upstream server tools before responding to list_tools (MCP mode only)

options.name: --force-roots-fallback
options.description: This mode can be used when the MCP client does not support the roots feature

options.name: --force-generate-tool-cache
options.description:
Deprecated (no-op). Kept for backward compatibility.
<client>                         Target client (positional, or use --all-ides): copilot-vscode, copilot-vs, copilot-cli, cursor, windsurf, kiro, gemini-antigravity, gemini-cli, junie-rider, claude-code, claude-desktop, codex-cli, jetbrains-air, opencode, unknown

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root (default: current directory)

options.name: --channel
options.description: Select the Uno MCP definition channel

options.name: --tool-version
options.description: Pin the Uno MCP tool definition to a specific version

options.name: --servers
options.description: Comma-separated server names (default: all)

options.name: --all-scopes
options.description: For mcp uninstall, remove matching registrations from every configured scope

options.name: --all-ides
options.description: For mcp install/uninstall without <client>, target all detected clients

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without modifying any files

options.name: --ide-definitions
options.description: Override embedded MCP client profiles

options.name: --server-definitions
options.description:
Override embedded server definitions
Note: MCP setup options choose the expected Uno MCP definition.
Any dnx --prerelease or dnx --version written to config files is derived output.
